title: fix(objectql): judge an authored action artifact-shipped by each holder's owner key, not by bare name
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D1TU5kbi4P8cud1uUdYQYCs)_
Fixes #32990

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：启动后的宿主上，`ObjectQLPlugin` 绑定环境自写的脚本 action 时，原来只要有任何代码包发布了同名 action 就跳过；现在逐个读每个持有者的同名 action，按它所属的对象判断：只有某个包的同名 action 拥有该行所在对象（或该 action 不绑定对象）时才跳过。声明式 `.custom` override 也按自己对象上的那个包匹配，不再按名字取第一个包。
- 为什么改：两个包在 `account`、`contact` 上各有 `approve`，环境在 `lead` 上自写 `approve` 时，#32987 已让 `/actions/lead/approve` 服务环境自己的声明，但它的脚本体从未被绑定，调用答 not found。
- 风险与回滚：只改 resync 的跳过判断；同对象上的环境行仍是持有者的定制（不绑定，持有者的 handler 照跑）；不绑定对象的包 action 仍覆盖所有对象；停用的持有者仍占住其对象。新增的绑定都在环境坐标（`metadata-service`）上，不进入任何包的坐标。不改存储、schema、spec。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`packages/objectql/src/plugin.ts`（`isArtifactShippedAction`、新的 `artifactActionsNamed`、`isDeclaredArtifactActionOverride` 中 `artifacts.find` 一行）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/plugin-authored-actions.test.ts -t 32990`，预期 6 条全部通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`ObjectQLPlugin.resyncAuthoredActions` binds runtime-authored script actions through the engine's default action runner, and skips a row a code package ships (the app plugin binds that package's handler under `app:PACKAGE`). The skip, `isArtifactShippedAction`, asked `registry.getArtifactItem('action', NAME)`: any code package's artifact of the bare name, on any object, skipped the row.

- `isArtifactShippedAction` now reads every code package's artifact of the name (`artifactActionsNamed`) and judges each by the object it owns, with the router's own predicate `standaloneActionOwnsRoute`: the row is artifact-shipped when an artifact owns the row's object, an object-less artifact owning every object. The embedded-in-a-packaged-object branch is unchanged.
- `artifactActionsNamed` (new, private): the registry's first match by bare name (what one holder always answered) plus each holder's own artifact (`packageScopedHoldersOf('action', NAME, null, { includeDisabledPackages: true })`, then `getArtifactItem` prefer-local per holder), deduplicated. Disabled packages count: a reversible disable never moves a binding.
- `isDeclaredArtifactActionOverride`: the base is the artifact on the row's own object among every holder's, not the first artifact by name. With one holder the answer is the same; with two, a declared override of the holder registered second is now recognised.
- `action-handler-coordinate.ts`: one docblock sentence follows the new judgement. No code change there.

No change to `packages/runtime`, `packages/metadata-protocol`, `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts` or `packages/spec`.

### FROM → TO

Composition: package A ships a script action `approve` on its object, package B one of the same name on its own, and the environment stores its own package-less script action `approve` on a third object. Readings are the engine dispatch on a booted kernel (`ObjectKernel` + `ObjectQLPlugin`, its `kernel:ready` resync).

| # | Case | FROM (`main` `e540baf8`) | TO | Clause-② arm |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | two holders (A, B), environment row on an object neither binds, both registration orders | dispatch there answers `Action 'approve' on object 'OBJECT' not found` | the environment's body runs; A's and B's run on their own objects, unqualified and package-qualified | widening |
| 2 | one holder (A), environment row on another object | not found | the environment's body runs; A's runs on its own | widening |
| 3 | `B.custom` declared override of B's action, A registered first | override not bound, B's body runs | the override's body runs over B's handler | widening |
| 4 | the same, B registered first | the override's body runs | unchanged | none |

Unchanged, pinned as CONTROLs: a package-less row on an object a holder's action owns stays that holder's customization (the holder's body runs), both orders; an object-less package action keeps a row on any other object unbound; a DISABLED holder registered after another still owns its object.

Row 2 is the one-holder case of the same defect: the declaration the route serves there is unchanged (the environment's own item, as `action-package-addressing.test.ts` `#32365` case 1 pins for the plain read), and what moves is that its body now has a handler. Named here so the seat can confirm it reads within the epic's "one-holder behaviour unchanged" red line (resolution untouched; the dispatch gains a handler).

## Tests

`packages/objectql/src/plugin-authored-actions.test.ts`: a new top-level describe `[#32990] …, on a booted kernel` (the file is this resync's harness). It boots `ObjectKernel` with `ObjectQLPlugin`, a row-store driver double and a test plugin standing in for the runtime's AppPlugin (installs the default action runner, registers each package through the manifest service during the cold boot and binds its handler under `app:PACKAGE`). Six cases: rows 1, 2 and 3/4 above (both registration orders where order matters), and the three CONTROLs.

Premise measured on the unmodified source (the pins committed first, `d2848f11`): case 1 answered `Action 'approve' on object 'env_lead' not found`; the override case answered `ran beta` with A registered first.

Ablations (each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: mutation landed by anchor count and blob hash, restore verified as blob equal to `HEAD` with an empty diff; the suite imports `./plugin.js` from source, so no rebuild is involved):

<details><summary>Five ablations, each red</summary>

1. the judgement by bare name (`artifactActionsNamed(name).length > 0`): 2 failed (two holders; one holder).
2. the per-holder artifact check never matches (`some(() => false)`): 2 failed (the disabled-holder and the object-less CONTROLs).
3. owner-key equality in place of `standaloneActionOwnsRoute`: 1 failed (the object-less CONTROL).
4. the override's base read as the first artifact (`artifacts[0]`): 1 failed (the override of the second holder).
5. nothing artifact-shipped (`return false` before both branches): 3 failed (the three CONTROLs, the same-object customization among them; that CONTROL is also held by the embedded-object branch, which is why ablation 2 leaves it green).

A first attempt at ablation 5 used a replacement that contained its own anchor; `ablation-replace` refused it (anchor count 1 to 1) and restored, so it ran nothing; it was re-run with a different anchor.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `ObjectQL`'s `arrivesAsDeclaredBase` (`packages/objectql/src/engine-actions.ts`) reads `getArtifactItem('action', NAME)` by bare name the same way when a declared base's handler arrives under an armed override. Not measured, not changed here; noted for the seat.
- `isArtifactShippedHook` stays name-only; ADR-0150 D4 names it as gaining the package, a separate card.
- First-party count: no first-party composition has two packages holding one action name beside an environment script action of that name.

## Verification

Head at open: `ab806df2`. Local readings so far: the dependency closure built (`pnpm --filter '@objectstack/objectql^...' build`, lock VERDICT command-exit 0); `vitest run src/plugin-authored-actions.test.ts src/action-activation.test.ts`: Test Files 2 passed (2), Tests 50 passed (50). The package's full test, its typecheck and the derived gate families follow in the `os-dev-report` comment on #32990; CI: see the check runs.
